# Najih — ناجح

> Najih (ناجح) is a free Moroccan Baccalaureate (الباكالوريا) preparation platform. It covers all branches (SM, SP, SVT, Eco, Lettres, Arts), interactive lessons, exercises, quick-tip PDFs and the official national exams 2022–2026 with their corrections. The site is fully bilingual Arabic/French and includes a free AI tutor that explains lessons, quizzes and national exams step by step.

## Branches (الشعب)
- [Science Mathématiques (SM)](https://najih.abouaaliahmed.com/branches/sm): lessons, quizzes and national exams for the Math branch.
- [Sciences Physiques (SP)](https://najih.abouaaliahmed.com/branches/sp): lessons, quizzes and national exams for the Physics branch.
- [Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre (SVT)](https://najih.abouaaliahmed.com/branches/svt): lessons, quizzes and national exams for the Biology branch.
- [Économie et Gestion (Eco)](https://najih.abouaaliahmed.com/branches/eco): lessons, quizzes and national exams for the Economics branch.
- [Lettres et Sciences Humaines](https://najih.abouaaliahmed.com/branches/lettres): lessons and exams for the Humanities branch.
- [Arts Appliqués](https://najih.abouaaliahmed.com/branches/arts): lessons and exams for the Applied Arts branch.

## AI tutor (المرشد الذكي)
- [Chat with the Najih AI tutor](/ai): explains lessons, solves national exam exercises step by step, always in Arabic/Darija or French, with worked examples.
- [Sitemap](https://najih.abouaaliahmed.com/sitemap.xml): full list of indexed pages (3,000+).
